checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same man, short grey hair, recognisable features
must.why: Hair, stubble, expression and face structure are close, though the face looks slightly older and more lined.
Charcoal blazer over white open-collar shirt.

must.item: Harsh lighting softened, realistic skin texture kept
must.why: Even soft lighting; skin texture is retained and looks natural.
Clean composition with no obvious artifacts. The head is slightly sharper and more refined, but it is acceptable.

faults.what: The face is slightly reinterpreted: deeper lines, a narrower jaw and a more rendered look, so it looks a bit older and more AI-generated than the original.

summary: A clean, professional grey-background headshot in a charcoal blazer and white shirt that clearly keeps the man's identity, with only slight facial reinterpretation that makes him look a bit older.
